day_shape: 67 items: IRGC claims Al-Ghayyah supertanker struck mines in Strait of Hormuz, US sanctions Russia's VTB Bank over Iran ties, second Sunni cleric killed in Zahedan, IDF pushes back on 'NAZA' Gaza AI documentary, IAEA reports near-zero Iran inspections in six months.

threads.label: Strait of Hormuz tanker incident
threads.summary: The IRGC Navy said the supertanker Al-Ghayyah (IMO 9325336) exploded after striking sea mines south of the Strait of Hormuz and remains ablaze, according to Fars and Defa Press. Jerusalem Post relayed the IRGC claim without a confirmed timing, alongside opinion pieces on Iran's ability to raise Hormuz risk and oil prices.

threads.label: US sanctions and IAEA access
threads.summary: The US imposed new Iran-related sanctions on Russia's VTB Bank over alleged sanctions-evasion assistance, while Iran International reported the IAEA has conducted almost no inspections in Iran for over six months. Iran's atomic energy official Kamalvandi called US moves to block Iran's participation in the IAEA general conference 'childish,' and UN Secretary-General Guterres stressed IAEA impartiality in a message to the 70th General Conference.

threads.label: Yemen, Houthis and Saudi Arabia
threads.summary: IRIB and Defa Press reported Houthi capture of the Kahbob heights overlooking Bab al-Mandab, a claimed Houthi missile strike on Najran, and 54 Saudi air strikes across five Yemeni provinces in 24 hours. Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman met CENTCOM chief Admiral Brad Cooper on Monday to discuss regional developments, per Saudi state television via Jerusalem Post.

threads.label: Sunni cleric killed in Zahedan
threads.summary: Sunni Baluch cleric Molavi Yousef Gorgij was shot dead outside his Zahedan home, the second such killing in under a week, per Iran International and Jerusalem Post. Iranian state media and the IRGC Quds Headquarters attributed the killing to 'terrorists' and 'agents of Zionism' seeking to disrupt Shia-Sunni unity.

threads.label: IDF response to 'NAZA' Gaza film
threads.summary: IDF Chief of Staff Lt. Gen. Eyal Zamir instructed the military's top legal official to examine legal action against the 'NAZA' documentary — which alleges AI-driven targeting of Gaza civilians — and ordered a leak inquiry. The IDF and Jerusalem Post rejected the film's claims, with scrutiny also directed at filmmaker Yuval Avraham's ties to Palestinian activist Ahmed Alnaouq.

threads.label: US pilot rescue inside Iran
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post and Iran International detailed a US search-and-rescue operation involving more than 90 troops that extracted an F-15 airman shot down over Iran in April, drawing online mockery of the IRGC. Defa Press argued CBS's documentary on the rescue amounted to a failed US propaganda effort.

threads.label: Pezeshkian regional messaging
threads.summary: President Pezeshkian said Iran has 'no problem with regional countries' but objects to US bases, and told India Today Iran is ready to revive the Silk Road and other corridors through its territory. FM spokesman Baghaei said Israel is the sole beneficiary of any Iran–Gulf rift, and announced Iraqi KDP leader Bafel Talabani's Tuesday visit to Tehran.

events.title_en: Yemeni army takes control of heights overlooking Bab al-Mandab Strait
events.summary_en: Yemeni sources reported on Monday of new battlefield advances by Houthi forces, saying these forces took control of the strategic heights of Kahbob. Sky News reported, citing these sources, that the Kahbob heights overlook the Bab al-Mandab Strait and the surrounding coasts and areas. Houthi forces are currently positioned in the mountains of the southern Taiz region. These sources stated that Houthi forces are attempting to re-besiege Taiz, noting that on Friday, after positioning themselves on the strategic island of Mayun in the middle of the strait, Houthi forces took control of the Bab al-Mandab area.

events.title_en: Emergency landing of Sepahan Boeing 737 in Mashhad
events.summary_en: A Sepahan Boeing 737 on the Mashhad-Kermanshah flight, after take-off, encountered a problem with one of the tyres and possible engine damage. The pilot declared an emergency and returned the aircraft to Mashhad airport, where it landed safely. Following this incident, runway 31 left at Mashhad airport was temporarily closed and there is a possibility of delays or changes to some arriving and departing flights.

events.summary_en: IRGC Navy Command: The super tanker Al-Ghayyah with IMO number 9325336, which sought to pass through a prohibited area south of the Strait of Hormuz, exploded after striking sea mines. Efforts to extinguish the fire have been unsuccessful and the entire tanker is engulfed in flames. Prior warning had been given about the danger of this illegal passage; the IRGC Navy declares with certainty that the Strait of Hormuz is closed and remains under our intelligent control.

events.summary_en: Spokesperson for Saudi-backed forces led by Tariq Salih on Monday admitted to the deaths and wounding of over 2,000 of his forces during clashes with Houthi forces in Yemen. He stated that his forces loyal to Riyadh are still counting their casualties, saying: we lose hundreds of our forces daily. These figures only occur in major battles.
